name: memory
display: Memory ICs (NOR/NAND flash, EEPROM, FRAM, SRAM, SDRAM, ROM)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 for avionics data/config/logging storage. ONE recipe for all memory types: there is no 'Memory Type' attribute in the data, but the derived table's common `subcategory` column is filterable, so route by --where "subcategory ~ NOR" / "~ EEPROM" / "~ FRAM" / "~ SRAM" / "~ NAND" / "~ SDRAM". Category is anchored to ^Memory$ so SD-card CONNECTORS and FIFO logic parts can't leak in.
columns: memsize parser kind (binary 1024 prefixes; 'B'/'Byte' = x8). Filter examples:
--where "size_bits >= 128Mbit", or a bare number of bits.
differentiator — FRAM is ~1e12+, worth checking when logging frequently.
__comment_twc__: the bare 'Write Cycle Time' alias substring-matches every
paren variant in the data: '(Tw)', '(tWC)', '(TWC)', no-space '(Tw)'.
